hint: The mode is the value that **appears most often**.
explanation: Count how often each value appears:
$4$ appears $3$ times. $6$ appears $2$ times. $7$ and $9$ each appear $1$ time.
$4$ appears the most — so the mode is $4$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Memory trick
steps: Mode = the value that appears MOst often.
